// Guard fixture: a corrected read, and the substring trap.
//
// host_rule_state_current contains host_rule_state as a substring. A
// matcher without a trailing word boundary reports this file as a
// violation, which would make the guard flag every read the change was
// meant to produce. A guard that fires on correct code gets weakened,
// so this fixture is what keeps the boundary in place.

package fixture

// ScoreHost reads the view, so it needs no registry entry.
func ScoreHost(hostID string) string {
	return `
		SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE current_status = 'pass'), COUNT(*)
		  FROM host_rule_state_current
		 WHERE host_id = $1`
}

// JoinView aliases the view, the other shape a real call site uses.
func JoinView() string {
	return `
		SELECT hrs.rule_id
		  FROM host_rule_state_current hrs
		  JOIN hosts h ON h.id = hrs.host_id AND h.deleted_at IS NULL`
}
